subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Al Capone Principle
description: A quick, practical guide to The Al Capone Principle.

hook.text: Al Capone ran a criminal empire. Murder, bootlegging, extortion. They got him for taxes.

buildup.text: Federal agents couldn't prove his violent crimes, so they followed the money instead.

discovery.text: Capone's lavish lifestyle didn't match his reported income. The gap was evidence of evasion.

twist.text: He was sentenced to 11 years — not for murder, but for failing to pay taxes on illegal income.

climax.text: The 'Capone method' — following money trails — remains the FBI's most effective prosecution tool.

punchline.text: The most dangerous gangster fell to an accountant.

quiz.question: What crime was Al Capone ultimately convicted of?
